title: Semi-Private Old Montréal Walking Tour by Guidatour
includes: All our prices already include local taxes to ensure ethical tourism.
Support a local, woman-owned company with 40 years of excellence by choosing a Guidatour experience.
A small sized group of maximum 8 travelers, ensuring an intimate experience for a great price
A relaxed, fun, and enjoyable 2.5-hour experience, led by the best guides Montréal has to offer
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: This tour goes on rain or shine - just be sure to dress for the day.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join a small group of up to 8 participants for an intimate, relaxed and complete 2.5-hour guided walking tour through the charming streets of Old Montréal. With a knowledgeable local guide, you’ll enjoy personalized attention, the opportunity to ask more questions, and a chance to form a deeper connection as you uncover the birthplace of the city at a comfortable pace.
